contracts.text: `helm template` must emit a unified manifest stream.
`helm install --dry-run` must emit a unified manifest stream.
`helm upgrade --dry-run` must emit a unified manifest stream.
`helm get manifest` must emit a unified manifest stream.
The unified stream orders documents by full `Source` path, sorted lexicographically.
Within a single template file, multi-document YAML is emitted in the same top-to-bottom order as rendered by the template engine.
Hooks are included in the unified manifest stream alongside non-hook resources.
For `helm install --dry-run` and `helm upgrade --dry-run`, output must present a single `MANIFEST` section (exactly one section header, not multiple).
In `helm get manifest` output, when hook and non-hook resources share the same `Source` path, hooks must be placed before non-hook resources within that source's documents.
contracts.adverse_condition: Hook and non-hook resources originate from the same Source path.

contracts.text: The dry-run `MANIFEST` section must not add extra trailing blank lines after the last document.
`helm template` output must end with a trailing newline character.
`helm upgrade --dry-run` output must not include the line `Happy Helming!`.
The unified manifest-stream behavior must be the default output mode for the four commands — no new flag, option, or environment variable is required to activate it.
Each document in the unified manifest stream is delimited by a `---` YAML document separator on its own line, including before the first document.
Each document in the unified manifest stream is annotated with a `# Source: <path>` comment line immediately following its `---` separator, where `<path>` is the full template source path.
All work must be done on a new branch created from `main`, and all changes must be committed when complete.
